name: Power Finance Corporation Ltd
title: Power Finance Corporation Ltd - 532810 - Transcript Of Analyst/Investor Meet Held On May 13, 2026

read.thesis: PFC is a lender, not a capacity operator: FY26 loan book grew only 7% as prepayments hit, FY27 loan growth guided ~10% and spread cut to 2.40–2.50%, while sanctions of INR 2.85 lakh crore sit mostly undisbursed.

triggers.label: Spread guided down to 2.40–2.50%
triggers.quote: we expect our spreads to be in the range of 2.40%to 2.50%

triggers.label: Loan growth FY26 7% vs 10-11% guided
triggers.quote: our loan book closed at around INR 5.8 lakh crore, reflecting 7% growth during the year

triggers.label: Banks refinancing commissioned renewable assets
triggers.quote: banks are more willing to take or do refinancing on the renewable portfolio

triggers.label: Sanctions INR 2.85 lakh cr, only ~80,000 cr disbursed
triggers.quote: out of INR 2.85 lakh crores I think around INR 80,000 only has been disbursed

guidance.quote: we expect our spreads to be in the range of 2.40%to 2.50%
we are targeting a loan growth of around 10% in Financial Year ‘27

prior_guidance_check.quote: Without these prepayments, our loan asset growth would have been within our guided range of 10-11%.

red_flags.label: Forex hedging cost surge
red_flags.quote: However, the actual loss is depending on the date of the maturity of the liability.

evasions.topic: Hedging cost FY27 sensitivity to INR
evasions.quote: However, the actual loss is depending on the date of the maturity of the liability.
it's very difficult to say about the disbursement figure
